documentary-realism.description: Photorealistic documentary footage with natural lighting and handheld camera feel

cinematic-dramatic.description: High-contrast cinematic look with dramatic lighting and widescreen framing

archival-historical.description: Aged film look with grain, slight color shift, and period-appropriate styling

data-visualization.description: Clean infographic style with charts, graphs, and data overlays

nature-organic.description: Lush natural environments with rich colors and organic textures

aerial-landscape.description: Sweeping aerial perspectives with drone-like camera movements
aerial-landscape.best_for: Establishing shots, geographic context, scale demonstration
aerial-landscape.avoid_for: Close-up details, personal interviews, indoor scenes

tech-futuristic.description: Sleek futuristic aesthetic with holographic elements and clean lines
tech-futuristic.best_for: Technology, AI, digital transformation, future predictions

noir-mystery.description: High-contrast noir styling with deep shadows and atmospheric lighting
noir-mystery.best_for: Investigative segments, corruption, hidden systems, conspiracy

sepia-nostalgia.description: Warm sepia tones with soft focus evoking memory and reflection
sepia-nostalgia.avoid_for: Breaking news, urgent topics, modern technology

minimal-clean.description: Minimalist aesthetic with white space, clean typography, and simple compositions
minimal-clean.avoid_for: Action sequences, emotional peaks, complex scenes

urban-gritty.description: Raw urban textures with street-level perspective and authentic grittiness
urban-gritty.best_for: Social issues, inequality, urban life, economic impact

abstract-conceptual.description: Abstract visual metaphors with fluid shapes and symbolic imagery
abstract-conceptual.best_for: Complex concepts, philosophical ideas, systemic explanations
abstract-conceptual.avoid_for: Concrete events, specific locations, factual reporting
